question.text: In-Principle Approval for a Cat III AIF:

answer.text: May be granted by SEBI to speed up registration, before Trust/LLP Deed registration completes
Is granted only after full documentation

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (p.97), SEBI may grant in-principle approval to eligible applicants before the Trust Deed or Partnership Deed has been registered, in order to speed up the overall registration process. The Trap: In-principle approval is not refused outright, nor is it permanent or contingent on full final documentation. Note: The Trust/Partnership Deed must be registered within 6 months of in-principle approval. Capital commitments may be accepted during this period, but money cannot be called or accepted from investors until the Registration Certificate is received.
